metadata.llm_reason: Candidate 8bd1e327 is a meta-skill that describes the general problem of length normalization in document scoring. Peer candidates 316d1204 (Pivoted Document Length Normalization) and 59e6dec3 (Maximum TF Normalization) are two distinct algorithmic implementations of this same objective. The candidate should merge into these two existing skills rather than persist as a separate abstraction layer, since the registry already contains the concrete normalization methods. The candidate's workflow steps and constraints are subsumed by the more specific implementations.
